title: Powered HETEROGENEITY certification of the expert-forecaster lever (#342, Codex path B)
rationale: Codex 2nd-opinion: the sign-fix (email>no-email) is partly common knowledge; the non-trivial product claim is WHO-RESPONDS-MORE. Certify heterogeneity at power before any engine change. Guards the 'LLM knows base rates vs simulates audience' blind spot.
design: gender(3) x recency(3) x channel(3) x email(2) strata from real Hillstrom RCT; 38 cases with n>=250/arm. Expert-forecaster elicitation (Sonnet primary, Groq stability). BOTH outcomes. Ground truth = real RCT uplifts.
PRIMARY_endpoint: VISIT heterogeneity Spearman rho across cases (label-permutation p, 5000)
secondary: gender-match differential (mens-email minus womens-email uplift, per gender/recency/channel triple)
PASS_FAIL_BAR: heterogeneity CERTIFIED iff VISIT Spearman rho > 0.30 AND permutation p < 0.05. Otherwise NULL (honest).
decision_rule: CERTIFIED -> real reason to consider an engine change (path A), personas demoted to interview/explanation surface. NOT CERTIFIED -> the lever fixes sign (base-rate-ish) but does NOT yet support the who-responds-more product claim; do NOT productize; report honest null.
model_stability_note: Sonnet-only is research-grade; productization needs cross-model evidence (Codex sequencing pt 3).
